description: This file defines a custom Log4j filter named OFBizDynamicThresholdFilter that dynamically adjusts logging thresholds based on context data, allowing for finely-tuned log level control within the Apache OFBiz project.

classes.name: OFBizDynamicThresholdFilter
classes.description: A custom Log4j filter that adjusts log level thresholds based on context data key-value pairs, enabling dynamic and context-sensitive logging behavior.

methods.name: createFilter
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of OFBizDynamicThresholdFilter with specified key, key-value pairs, and actions for match and mismatch.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides equality check to compare filter configurations.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Determines whether a log event should be logged based on the dynamic threshold logic, examining event level and context data.

methods.name: currentContextData
methods.description: Retrieves current thread-specific context data used for threshold decision-making.
